🎉 *WELCOME* - {prefix}{command} welcome

👋 *BYE* - {prefix}{command} bye
   Enables or disables the goodbye message when someone leaves the group.

🚫 *ANTILINK* - {prefix}{command} antilink

🚫 *ANTILINK2* - {prefix}{command} antilink2
   Stronger anti-link system, detects almost any link.

🔐 *RESTRICT* - {prefix}{command} restrict {value}
   Enables group restrictions (owner only).

📖 *AUTOREAD* - {prefix}{command} autoread {value}
   Automatically marks all messages as read.

🎵 *AUDIOS* - {prefix}{command} audios
   Enables or disables automatic audio responses.

🏷️ *AUTOSTICKER* - {prefix}{command} autosticker

📞 *ANTICALL* - {prefix}{command} anticall {value}
   Automatically blocks incoming calls.

☢️ *ANTITOXIC* - {prefix}{command} antitoxic
   Detects and removes toxic messages.

👑 *ADMINMODE* - {prefix}{command} modoadmin
   Only admins can use bot commands.

⏰ *AFK* - {prefix}{command} afk
   Controls AFK mode usage.

🗑️ *ANTIDELETE* - {prefix}{command} antidelete
   Prevents message deletion.

📊 *AUDIOS_BOT* - {prefix}{command} audios_bot {value}
   Enables or disables bot audios.

🎯 *ANTISPAM* - {prefix}{command} antispam {value}
   Blocks spam users.

📝 *ANTIPRIVATE* - {prefix}{command} antiprivado {value}
   Blocks private messages.

🌐 *PUBLICMODE* - {prefix}{command} modopublico {value}
   Switches to public mode.

👀 *VIEWIMAGE* - {prefix}{command} viewimage {value}
   Enables image preview.

🢀 *GROUPMODE* - {prefix}{command} modogrupos {value}

gc_settag.ayuda:
✍️ *How to customize the summon message*

Send:
*{usedPrefix}settag <your text>*

You can use these words anywhere in your text (no braces or special symbols needed):
• bot → bot name
• grupo → group name
• tag → mentions whoever summoned
• razon → the reason typed when summoning
• tags → list of all tagged members

You can write your text with emojis and real line breaks (just like you'd see it in WhatsApp), and the final message will respect exactly those line breaks.

📷 If you want the message to include an image, reply to an image (or send it with the text as the caption) using *{usedPrefix}settag*.

*📌 Usage example:*
```
{usedPrefix}settag 🎉 Attention grupo 🎉

tag is summoning you.
📋 Reason: razon

👥 Members:
tags
```

*👀 This is how the final result would look:*
```
🎉 Attention The Regulars 🎉

@5491122334455 is summoning you.
📋 Reason: important meeting

👥 Members:
┃>@5491111111111
┃>@5492222222222
┃>@5493333333333
```

Once you're done you'll see a preview with your group's real data. If you like it, confirm with *{usedPrefix}setconfir*. If not, send *{usedPrefix}settag <text>* again with your changes.
